description: This file defines a command handler for deleting a customer within the application layer of a C# project, implementing the IRequestHandler interface from MediatR. It interacts with the customer repository to fetch and delete a customer by ID.

classes.name: DeleteCustomerCommandHandler
classes.description: A class responsible for handling delete customer commands, utilizing the customer repository to perform delete operations.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Asynchronously handles the delete customer command by retrieving and deleting the customer if found.
